name: meshcore-g2
description: MeshCore G2 HUD for Even Realities G2 glasses

scripts.check: npm run check:even && npm run check:android
scripts.check:even: npm run versions:check && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build:even
scripts.build:even: npm run typecheck && vite build --config apps/even/vite.config.ts
scripts.pack:even: npm run build:even && node scripts/artifacts.mjs even
scripts.pack: npm run pack:even && npm run build:android && node scripts/artifacts.mjs android debug && node scripts/artifacts.mjs bundle debug
